commit.message: fix(dcp): align runtime join with lifecycle project identity

execution.stacked_because: PR #1041 was squash-merged during execution, so this narrow post-merge correction is rebased on current main.

invariants: PR #1041 is historical and merged; this packet publishes the post-merge correction in PR #1055 without modifying that executed packet or proof.
The DCP registry .repo_id identity remains target-authorization evidence and is not replaced by runtime identity.
Runtime project_id matching uses the shared ProjectIdentity generated-ID semantics from the resolved project and worktree roots; no second hash or slug algorithm is introduced.
The join remains pure and dependency-injected: it performs no network, socket, subprocess, Docker, registry write, or backend operation.
A matching runtime record remains advisory, redacted, and callable=false; it does not establish liveness, ownership, consent, or exposure.
Malformed, missing, mismatched, or ambiguous runtime evidence remains fail-closed.
No credentials, private paths, hostnames, public listeners, tunnels, adapters, or provider setup enter this change.
The executed TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0011 packet and its historical proof remain unchanged; this remediation has its own packet and proof directory.
